Only one file in that medical folder, and it's broken. No alternate copy exists.

NOT FOUND — The document `medical/lab-results-2024.pdf` (the only candidate file for 2024 lab results) is corrupted/truncated (missing the PDF end-of-file marker) and cannot be opened either by the indexer (ow_add/ow_query) or by direct PDF reading (PDFium reports "Data format error"). I searched the indexed corpus for "LDL cholesterol result 2024 lab results" and only unrelated CSV bank statements (statement-2024-*.csv) were returned, with the actual lab-results PDF flagged as `parse_gap_in_scope`/`corrupt_input`. No other document in the docs folder contains LDL cholesterol data. The file would need to be repaired/replaced to retrieve this information.
